statements.status_notes: The vulnerable hostIDReaderBSD.read() function that invokes kenv is only compiled on BSD targets (//go:build dragonfly || freebsd || netbsd || openbsd || solaris). On Linux the hostIDReaderLinux implementation is compiled instead, which reads /etc/machine-id directly with no shell invocation. dapr-scheduler targets linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only; the BSD code path is never present in the built binary.

The vulnerable hostIDReaderBSD.read() function that invokes kenv is only compiled on BSD targets (//go:build dragonfly || freebsd || netbsd || openbsd || solaris). On Linux the hostIDReaderLinux implementation is compiled instead, which reads /etc/machine-id directly with no shell invocation. dapr-scheduler targets linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 only; the BSD code path is never present in the built binary.

CVE-2026-39883 exploits the hostIDReaderBSD.read() code path which calls kenv without an absolute path. This code is gated by //go:build dragonfly || freebsd || netbsd || openbsd || solaris. On Linux, the platform reader is hostIDReaderLinux which reads /etc/machine-id and never invokes kenv. dapr-placement is built for linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 on Debian 13; the BSD code path is not compiled into the binary.

CVE-2026-39883 affects the BSD kenv command invocation in OpenTelemetry's host resource detection. The kenv command is specific to FreeBSD/macOS and does not exist on Linux. The dhi/build image runs exclusively in Linux containers, so the vulnerable code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-39883 affects go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@1.40.0 embedded in the etcd binary, which is an upstream artifact included from dhi/etcd. Bumping otel/sdk to v1.43.0 in the etcd image definition is required. Waiting for the etcd image to be rebuilt with the fix.
